record: Brisbane replication: do sustained rises in Wikipedia interest by theme predict more borrowing of books on that theme in a second city, Brisbane City Council Libraries (Australia)?
fixed_by: Khant Phyo Wai (with Claude); Khant delegated dataset decisions in chat on 2026-10-15
outcomes_seen: No Brisbane borrowing has been linked to interest. Known before fixing: all Seattle results (Studies 3, 3b, 4, 4b, 2R), the exploratory dose-response and the size-versus-duration checks. The 2023-2025 Brisbane files were profiled (counts of loans and days only).
data: Brisbane City Council library checkouts (Queensland Government open data, CC BY 4.0), yearly files 2015 to 2025 as published (sampled checkout days); loans aggregated to calendar months; a month is usable only if it has at least 2 sampled days
themes: each Brisbane title is matched to a Seattle work by normalised title and author family name (exact match after normalisation, same rule for all titles) and inherits that work's theme profile from taxonomy version 3; unmatched titles are left out; the match rate by year is reported
demand: a theme's monthly borrowing = sum of matched loans weighted by theme strength; exposure = all loans in that month; formats pooled, with a print versus other split reported if item_type allows
closures: a month whose total loans fall below half of the median of the previous 12 months (at least 6 needed) is missing
shifts: the Study 3 Wikipedia shifts unchanged (quality OK, non-seasonal), narrow and middle levels, month 0 from 2016-01 to 2025-06
outcome_model: the Study 3b count model unchanged apart from formats (a single pooled series, or print and other if split), fitted on the 24 months ending at month -7, tau over months 0 to 2, placebo-category rank on z, bootstrap clustered by theme (2,000, seed 20261015)

hypotheses.H1: pooled tau of sustained rises > 0 with its 95% bootstrap interval above 0
hypotheses.H2: pooled tau of sustained rises minus pooled tau of fading rises > 0 with its 95% interval above 0

secondary: positive controls reported first: COVID-19 (March 2020) and George Floyd (June 2020), with Brisbane closure months marked
joint regression of tau on log2 whole duration and log2 peak size, bootstrap clustered by theme
power from injected lifts as in Study 3b (+20%, +50%, +100%; 200 draws)
label: a second-city replication of the Seattle theme-level design using the same global English Wikipedia interest series
